plugins.name: investigation-discipline
plugins.description: Reasoning gates for investigation, triage, exposure review and incident response. Converts findings into answers: close unknowns rather than labelling them, trace to the sink, check for an upstream fix, prove negatives before reporting them, and ship one decision with an owner and a test.
